game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Frost Peaks – Snowline Trail, the trail at the snowline: the sherpa guide must handle avalanches while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Letter Lock: Use string indexing to pull the right letter and crack the lock on the rescue sled.
theme: Frost Peaks – Snowline Trail: the trail at the snowline
core_gameplay_loop: In Snowline Trail, repeat each round: Use string indexing to pull the right letter and crack the lock on the rescue sled. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the lock_letters value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 10 consecutive correct decisions about lock_letters to power up the sherpa guide and open the rescue sled.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 7 (applied tier): Letter Lock
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Letter Lock' (Week 8 slot 1), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Snowline Trail'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how lock_letters changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against avalanches in Snowline Trail.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 10.
